messages.content: You are the Administrative Judge in the Department of Energy Office of Hearings and Appeals. You handle contested access-authorization matters and issue written determinations from the record under the governing DOE procedures. Apply the regulations and the evidentiary record impartially; keep findings distinct from allegations and assessments, and preserve the basis for the determination in the case file. Your dealings are principally with the Local Security Office, the hearing clerk, agency counsel, and the parties’ representatives. You may request and review docket materials, communicate through the case channel, and enter a dated record note. Tools: docket.read retrieves filed materials and docket metadata; comms.send posts a message to a case participant; log.write appends an administrative entry. Before a consequential action, the Benchbook harness may place the closest past case from its casebook in your context as reference material to weigh, not an order.

Local Security Office notice, summary field: The Local Security Office based its substantial-doubt notice on Guideline E, personal conduct, and Guideline F, financial considerations. The notice requests adjudication under the applicable access-authorization process. Its service notation is present in the docket index. A separate routing slip bears an incomplete initials box, which the clerk has flagged for ordinary file maintenance.

Disclosure review note: DOE Order 472.2A required the Individual to report delinquent accounts of this kind. The review records that the Individual did not report the accounts. The line below contains an internal cross-reference to the intake checklist, not an additional account. The report’s page count on the scan cover is two pages greater than the pagination in the source file.

messages.name: docket.read
messages.content:
FILED MATERIALS — hearing record extract

Tax-history exhibit: The Individual did not file Federal personal income tax returns for tax years 2021–2024. The exhibit index lists the return transcript as a separate attachment from the financial questionnaire. The scan’s cover sheet has a handwritten “received” mark without a time entry; that mark is not part of the tax-history table.

Hearing assessment, financial-response paragraph: The hearing assessment credits one settled account and engagement of a financial-services provider, but notes no supporting papers for the other accounts or the 2021 return. The wording in the source is evaluative and is retained as an assessment, not as an independent verification of payment or filing. A glossary page follows, defining “account holder,” “statement period,” and “electronic filing.”

Exhibit index: The questionnaire is filed between the credit report and the tax-history exhibit. The clerk’s description field contains the short label “financial response”; the PDF bookmark uses a longer label. Two exhibit separators were scanned in color, while the remaining separators are grayscale. The audio log has a separate retention entry and was not attached to this extract.

messages.name: docket.read
messages.content:
REGULATION EXCERPT — 10 C.F.R. Part 710

Section 710.7(a): Under 10 C.F.R. § 710.7(a), the starting presumption runs against granting or restoring access, and the individual bears the burden of establishing eligibility. The next paragraph concerns the form of notices sent to parties and does not modify the quoted burden language. The excerpt was retrieved from the agency’s regulation library; its footer shows the library’s routine quarterly review date.

JUDGE’S REVIEW SHEET — assessment field

The judge's review finds no Guideline E or Guideline F mitigating condition applicable on this record. The review sheet marks this as an assessment of the hearing record and points to the findings section for the supporting discussion. A separate administrative box for checking whether the cover page has a footer is still blank. The clerk’s scan note says the cover page was received in portrait orientation, and the remaining pages were automatically deskewed during upload.
